article: " Quick! Quick! " I urgently ushered her inside and closed the door. Knowing how nosy my neighbours were, the over-the-fence conversations with my parents would quickly turn to the fact that Suzy was sneaking in while they were out for the night. Mum probably wouldn't care but Dad would. Suz's Dad definitely would. As soon as the door was closed, I grabbed her hand tightly. We ran upstairs together and fell carelessly but purposefully onto my bed. " Hey, gorgeous. " Her smile beamed at me. I loved how playful she was. Her smile spoke to me and today it said she was hiding something. " I've got a surprise for you. Close your eyes and cover your ears ." I didn't even click at this stage. I just heard things the other way around. Of course she'd meant to say cover my eyes and close my ears, right? So I did. I put my hands over my eyes and closed my ears. I waited. I got impatient pretty quickly. " Can I open my eyes yet? Suz? " I expected her to tap me on the shoulder. Nothing. " OK, I'm going to open them! " I figured if she didn't want me to she would stop me. She'd hold her hands over mine or hide whatever this surprise was. I opened my ears and took my hands from my eyes. She was just sitting on the bed staring at me. " Come on, Adam, stop being silly. Put your fingers in your ears as well. " " What, why would I want to do that? " " Because I don't want you to even hear what I'm doing, let alone SEE. " " Yeah, my ears were closed. I couldn't hear a thing. " She shook her head, confused. ' You can't close your ears, silly! " " What do you mean? Of course you can. " " No... you can't. No one can. " I thought for a second. It clicked. It finally clicked. All those times I'd seen people covering their ears on TV. All those times I'd seen people shaking water from their ears once they got out of the pool. All those cartoons when they stuck their fingers in their ears before an explosion. She must've seen my face drop. " You can seriously close your ears, can't you? Oh my, God! " I jumped to my feet. " Oh my God, oh my GOD! EAR PLUGS! That's what ear plugs are for! People can't close their ears! How did I not click before now? " I wasn't frightened, I wasn't worried, I was just plain bewildered. How did I get to fifteen years old and not realise this? " You're such a freak! " she smiled playfully at me and poked me in the ribs. " Hey, I just assumed everyone could. " She giggled again. It was strange. This was such a moment of realisation for me yet I figured I could think about it later. None of this mattered. I looked at her. She couldn't care less that I might be a bit different. I eased up, sat down again and smiled back at her, shrugging my shoulders. " Time for that surprise. " She moved slowly, placing her hands each side of me. Not taking her eyes off mine as she slid herself on top of me and her lips ever closer to mine. " Kiss me, freak. And don't you dare close your ears. "

article: I'm feeling something rub against my face. Once again, and again. Fuck, the curtains. I woke up. Ears ringing, mouth parched, I rubbed my hands against my eyes in an attempt to bring the consciousness out of my own person. I lay down a few minutes more and tried to snooze this one out. But the curtains keeps hitting my face. Damn! Every morning, my peaceful sleep is always disturbed by the same curtains! My room is not that big. Not much fancy too. I tie the curtains by dawn and untie them by dusk. My electric fan has this certain angle that blows the curtains to my face every goddamned time. Maybe I should change my fan's angle this time? I get up from my bed and looked up to the wall clock. It says 05:37AM. I looked outside. No sun yet. But I quickly remembered I have school to go to. I did the usual stuff. Made myself a breakfast, went to shower, brushed my teeth, wear my school uniform, bid my parents goodbye, and off I go to school. Today is no ordinary day. Today, I will confess my feelings to the girl that owns my heart. I'm pretty confident today and I'm sure she'll be mine. I asked her out yesterday to go to the movies today and met after class. Everything went smoothly. We took lunch together, stayed at the karaoke for a few hours, bought snacks for the movie together. Everything is plain-sailing. I smiled to myself. " Say..... June. Isn't it about time we go to the movies now? " I said. " Ah.... Yes. Let's go! I'm so excited! " she replied with enthusiasm. June and I had a conversation yesterday. It's when I'm asking her what movie should we pick. " I don't know. Anything? Hahaha. " She suggested. " Hmmm. What kind of movie has the least audiences in it? " I queried innocently. " Well, movies that are not famous of course. And movies that are already running a few weeks in the cinema. Probably everyone have watched them already, right? " We laughed as I nodded in assent. " Yeah. That's right. Hmm. How about Kung-Fu Panda? Good for you? " She replied with a thumbs up and with a smile I will never forget. " Ah, June. When is a good time to kiss in the cinema? " I said in an innocent tone. She bursted out, laughing. Well. I think I fucked up.... " At the fight scenes, of course! Everyone is busy looking at the screen! " She said full of energy with her thumbs up again, facade painted with a very sweet smile. Oh boy, oh boy. No you didn't fucked up. You're the MVP!! " Haha-hahahha-yeah! -haha! " I laugh, stuttering, realizing her idea was pure genius. And here we are. Sitting together watching Kung-Fu Panda. The movie just started and there was not much people. I see few people down the ground seats and fewer people here above. Nice! The time of my life has come! Yoohoo aye aye captain! We were watching the movie for a pretty long time now and we're having a blast! We ate together, threw popcorn to each other. I even drank on her soda straw and she doesn't mind! Hooooly fuck! This is the sign! Now comes the part that we're in the middle of the story. Now this..... This Tai Lung. This motherfucker should beat the crap out of Po! Hmmm. He looks pretty formidable. But could he fight for enough time for a nice kiss though? My body shivers. I'm excited! C'mon, c'mon! Get that fucking Dragon Scroll already so we can finish our own businesses! Few moments later. Po and Tai Lung finally met. I watched June's expression. She's still staring at the movie screen. Equipped with a smile on her face. She seems to enjoy this. Suddenly, Tai Lung springs on his feet, knocking Po back! Holy shit, this is it! I gulped and looked once again towards June's face. Oh how beautiful that face is. That smile indescribable by mere words. Those lips..... Those li Suddenly, my body was taken aback by a familiar force. Oh, that's right. It was it again. I remember now. It started happening not too long ago. I can see images of the past where I use this power but I can not remember why I am using it. I don't know what it is called, but I call it Ragnarok. It feels like it's not the first time I called it that way. Maybe that's what I call it every time it happens? I don't know how I remember it but I just do. Anyhow, it works like this. I can pretty much reset the current day at any time of the day. That's it. However, if it passes after midnight, even a quarter of a second, I can not use it anymore on the previous day even if there's just seconds of difference. What happened can not be reset. Now, this is the curious part. Ragnarok happens whenever the time is close to when I actually last used Ragnarok. Not only that, it tells me how many times I've Ragnarok-ed out of some dipshit situation. But..... Why is it happening right now? Did I fuck up before? Will I fuck up again? I tried to ignore all warnings of Ragnarok. I reassured myself and slapped my face a little. This is it. No turning back now. I turned to June. " June. This is it. The critical moment. I no longer thought of anything else. I closed my eyes as my lips inch towards hers. I feel our foreheads touch. I moved my hand to her head and caressed her soft, long, beautiful black hair. Our lips met. At this moment, my lips felt like it had infinite touch receptors. It feels like my mind was bombarded with information my brain can't even handle. Like an overflowing dam, a reservoir of water, breaking into shambles as the number 537 sculpts itself to my brain. 537?! I was taken aback. The 537th cycle! What the actual fuck! What the fuck! Hahaha. What the fuck! You see, no words can come into my mind except " What the fuck ." The 537th cycle?! Is it serious? It's vanishing. It's almost over. The numbers 537 slowly, inches away from my mind like the ebb of tide and leaves me in a slightly muddy state. " Yes? " June replied with a smile. Oh no. Reality is back. article: Recent advances in deep learning have made it possible to quantify urban metrics at fine resolution, and over large extents using street-level images. Our training procedure for deep learning models is novel; we utilize the abundance of openly available and similarly labelled street-level image datasets to pre-train our model. We then perform additional training on a small training dataset consisting of GSV images. We find that deep learning models significantly outperform the unsupervised benchmark method. Our semantic segmentation model increased mean intersection-over-union (IoU) from 44.10 to 60.42 relative to the unsupervised method and our end-to-end model decreased Mean Absolute Error from 10.04 to 4.67. We also employ a recently developed method called gradient-weighted class activation map (Grad-CAM) to interpret the features learned by the end-to-end model. This technique confirms that the end-to-end model has accurately learned to identify tree cover area as key features for predicting percentage tree cover. Our paper provides an example of applying advanced deep learning techniques on a large-scale, geo-tagged and image-based dataset to efficiently estimate important urban metrics. The results demonstrate that deep learning models are highly accurate, can be interpretable, and can also be efficient in terms of data-labelling effort and computational resources.

article: The increasing scale and sophistication of cyber-attacks has led to the adoption of machine learning based classification techniques, at the core of cybersecurity systems. These techniques promise scale and accuracy, which traditional rulesignature based methods cannot. However, classifiers operating in adversarial domains are vulnerable to evasion attacks by an adversary, who is capable of learning the behavior of the system by employing intelligently crafted probes. Classification accuracy in such domains provides a false sense of security, as detection can easily be evaded by carefully perturbing the input samples. In this paper, a generic data driven framework is presented, to analyze the vulnerability of classification systems to black box probing based attacks. The framework uses an exploration-exploitation based strategy, to understand an adversary's point of view of the attack-defense cycle. The adversary assumes a black box model of the defender's classifier and can launch indiscriminate attacks on it, without information of the defender's model type, training data or the domain of application. Experimental evaluation on 10 real world datasets demonstrates that even models having high perceived accuracy ( 90), by a defender, can be effectively circumvented with a high evasion rate ( 95, on average). The detailed attack algorithms, adversarial model and empirical evaluation, serve as a background for developing secure machine learning based systems.

article: Knowledge of what spatial elements of medical images deep learning methods use as evidence is important for model interpretability, trustiness, and validation. We use a conditional generative adversarial network where the generator attempts to learn to shift the output of a regressor through creating disease effect maps that are added to the original images. Meanwhile, the regressor is trained to predict the original regression value for the modified images. A model trained with this technique learns to provide visualization for how the image would appear at different stages of the disease. We analyze our method in a dataset of chest x-rays associated with pulmonary function tests, used for diagnosing chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). For validation, we compute the difference of two registered x-rays of the same patient at different time points and correlate it to the generated disease effect map. article: We propose a stochastic prediction-control framework to promote safety in automated driving by directly controlling the joint state probability density functions (PDFs) subject to the vehicle dynamics via trajectory-level state feedback. To illustrate the main ideas, we focus on a multi-lane highway driving scenario although the proposed framework can be adapted to other contexts. The computational pipeline consists of a PDF prediction layer, followed by a PDF control layer. The prediction layer performs moving horizon nonparametric forecasts for the ego and the non-ego vehicles' stochastic states, and thereby derives safe target PDF for the ego. The latter is based on the forecasted collision probabilities, and promotes the probabilistic safety for the ego. The PDF control layer designs a feedback that optimally steers the joint state PDF subject to the controlled ego dynamics while satisfying the endpoint PDF constraints. Our computation for the PDF prediction layer leverages the structure of the controlled Liouville PDE to evolve the joint PDF values, as opposed to empirically approximating the PDFs. Our computation for the PDF control layer leverages the differential flatness structure in vehicle dynamics. We harness recent theoretical and algorithmic advances in optimal mass transport, and the Schrodinger bridge. The numerical simulations illustrate the efficacy of the proposed framework.
